source.attribution: Bureau of Transportation, Tokyo Metropolitan Government / Association for Open Data of Public Transportation

declaredScope.scopeStatement: All records for Toei GTFS route_id 4, including every referenced trip, stop-time, calendar, and calendar-date record; not a sample.

scopeVerification.routeSelection: exact route_id=4 retained; five other source routes excluded
scopeVerification.tripReferences: all retained trips have route_id=4 and every route_id=4 trip is retained
scopeVerification.stopTimeReferences: all stop_times for retained trips are retained
scopeVerification.stopReferences: all stop_ids referenced by retained stop_times are retained
scopeVerification.calendarReferences: all retained service_ids are represented by retained calendar or calendar_dates rows
scopeVerification.agencyReferences: all retained route agency_ids are represented by retained agency rows
scopeVerification.transfers: transfers.txt absent from pinned source; normalized transfers are empty

transformation: The committed artifact is a deterministic normalization of the filtered Toei GTFS records into Meguruto's existing ScheduledTransitDataset graph. It modifies/transforms source rows; it does not claim to be the unmodified source feed.
